ops_dup_cleanup_confirm_text: Repeated database records of the same file are deleted, with their related data. Files on disk aren’t touched. This can’t be undone.
ops_dup_delete_confirm_text: They’re permanently deleted from disk with their records, freeing {size}. This can’t be undone.
ops_dup_intro: Compares the files’ SHA-256 hash to find identical copies.
ops_dup_last_copy: It’s the only copy being kept
ops_dup_leave_stops: Leaving this page stops the search.
ops_dup_mode_analyze_hint: Counts the duplicates in the database without touching anything.
ops_dup_mode_cleanup_hint: Removes repeated database records of the same file.
ops_dup_mode_physical_hint: Looks for identical files on disk and lets you choose which to delete.
ops_dup_review_hint: Click a file to switch between keeping and deleting it. At least one always stays.
ops_error_unknown_action: The server doesn't know this action (an older version?).
ops_failures_intro: Metadata, thumbnail and analysis tasks that failed, for every user, with their cause.

match.countPlural=one: The task in the current filter is queued again. If the file itself is the cause, it will fail the same way.
match.countPlural=other: The {count} tasks in the current filter are queued again. Those failing because of the file itself will fail the same way.

match.countPlural=one: {count} task dismissed: it won’t be retried.
match.countPlural=other: {count} tasks dismissed: they won’t be retried.

ops_field_suggestion_band: Must be equal to or above the clustering threshold.
ops_field_url: Must be an http:// or https:// address.
ops_kind_needs_action_hint: The feature is switched off or its model didn’t load. Fix the service, then retry everything.
ops_kind_permanent_hint: The file itself fails the same way every time (unreadable, rejected format). Retrying is pointless: fix it or dismiss it.
ops_kind_transient_hint: The service was unreachable or timed out: retrying later usually works.
ops_kind_unknown_hint: An older failure, or one that couldn’t be classified.
ops_mt_clustering_hint: Groups the faces already detected into people again, for every user.
ops_mt_coverage_desc: Walks the disk the way the indexer does and checks every file is indexed.

match.countPlural=one: {count} external library was offline and wasn’t checked.
match.countPlural=other: {count} external libraries were offline and weren’t checked.

ops_mt_coverage_truncated: The list is cut short: there are more.
ops_mt_dates_desc: Recomputes the capture date from EXIF and, when missing, from the name or the file.
ops_mt_duplicates_desc: Finds identical copies by hash and lets you choose which to keep.
ops_mt_embedding_desc: Computes the embeddings to search by describing the photo, in any language.
ops_mt_empty_trash_confirm_text: Everything in any user’s trash, not just yours, will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
ops_mt_empty_trash_desc: Permanently deletes everything in every user’s trash.
ops_mt_faces_desc: Detects faces and groups them into people.
ops_mt_geocode_desc: Names the city and country of each set of coordinates.
ops_mt_geocode_no_dataset: This installation has no city dataset: the task won’t resolve any place.

match.countPlural=one: {count} photo with coordinates but no place · {cities} known cities
match.countPlural=other: {count} photos with coordinates but no place · {cities} known cities

ops_mt_index_desc: Scans the folders, adds new files and flags missing ones.
ops_mt_interpolate_desc: Gives coordinates to photos taken next to others with GPS.
ops_mt_intro: Index, analyse, repair and clean up. Each task keeps running on the server if you leave.
ops_mt_media_desc: Pairs photos with their video again and recognises panoramas, screenshots and bursts.
ops_mt_metadata_desc: Reads EXIF, GPS and IPTC from photos and videos that don’t have them yet.
ops_mt_missing_desc: Flags as missing the assets whose file is no longer on disk.
ops_mt_objects_desc: Detects objects to tag and search photos.
ops_mt_opt_dry_run_hint: Says how many would change, without changing anything.
ops_mt_opt_file_date: Fall back to the file’s date
ops_mt_opt_file_date_hint: Its modification date on disk, which may not be the capture date.
ops_mt_opt_from_file_hint: Slower; otherwise the EXIF stored in the database is used.
ops_mt_opt_infer_path: Infer from the name and folder
ops_mt_opt_infer_path_hint: For photos without an EXIF date: IMG_20240512, 2024/05…
ops_mt_opt_overwrite_hint: Including those that already have metadata.
ops_mt_opt_regenerate_hint: After changing the format or quality in Settings.
ops_mt_opt_simulate_hint: Counts what would be purged, without deleting anything.
ops_mt_opt_write_file: Write the inferred date into the file
ops_mt_opt_write_file_hint: So it survives a database rebuild.
ops_mt_orphans_desc: Deletes thumbnails on disk with no asset behind them. They can be regenerated.
ops_mt_purge_confirm: Purge the assets without a file?
ops_mt_purge_confirm_text: Assets flagged as missing and folders whose directory no longer exists will be removed from the database, along with their albums and faces. This can’t be undone. If in doubt, run it with “Simulate only” first.
ops_mt_purge_desc: Removes from the database the assets flagged as missing and folders that no longer exist.
ops_mt_scenes_desc: Recognises the kind of scene (beach, mountain, indoors…).
ops_mt_section_ai_hint: Queues what’s pending; the models process it in the background.
ops_mt_section_cleanup_hint: Frees space. This is where things get deleted.
ops_mt_section_memories_hint: Each one feeds the next, in this order.
ops_mt_section_new_hint: After adding files, in this order.
ops_mt_sizes_desc: Reads every file’s size again to fix the quotas.
ops_mt_text_desc: Reads the text in images so it can be searched.
ops_mt_trips_desc: Looks for runs of photos away from home.
ops_nightly_last_hint: The scheduler checks every minute whether it’s time; the cycle runs once a day.
ops_nightly_never: No nightly cycle has run yet.
ops_nightly_reset_done: The cycle will run again at the next scheduled time.
ops_notif_purge_hint: Deletes those past the retention (or every read one if retention is 0). It also happens every night.
ops_notif_purge_text: Notifications past the retention are deleted for every user. This can’t be undone.
ops_perf_hint: More workers speed things up but use more CPU and memory. Better not to exceed the core count, especially for models.
ops_perf_restart: Model workers are created when the server starts: restart it for changes to apply.

match.deletedPlural=one: Queue emptied: {deleted} job removed; {busy} running will finish on their own.
match.deletedPlural=other: Queue emptied: {deleted} jobs removed; {busy} running will finish on their own.

ops_queue_empty_confirm_text: Waiting jobs and those waiting for a retry are removed. Jobs already running finish on their own. The photos stay pending: you can queue them again any time.
ops_queue_enqueued: {task}: queued {enqueued} of {total} in {time}. They’ll be processed in the background.
ops_queues_hint: Per-photo jobs: metadata, thumbnails and AI models.
ops_set_demo: Read-only in the demo: server settings can’t be changed.
ops_set_device_hint: Where it runs. “GPU” needs the ML image with CUDA; without it, the CPU is used.
ops_set_device_ocr_warning: OCR on a GPU reserves a lot of video memory. On a shared GPU it can run out and fail with “out of memory”; if it does, leave it on CPU.
ops_set_embedding_desc: CLIP embeddings to search by describing the photo.
ops_set_embedding_model_hint: Stable identifier of the CLIP model. Default: mclip-vit-b32-v1.
ops_set_embedding_model_warning: Changing the version invalidates every embedding. Until they’re all reprocessed, search mixes old and new vectors and gives inconsistent results.
ops_set_faces_clustering_hint: Maximum distance for two faces to be the same person. Typical: 0.40–0.45.
ops_set_faces_desc: Face detection and grouping into people.
ops_set_faces_knn_hint: How many similar faces are looked up per face.
ops_set_faces_knn_switch_hint: With more unassigned faces than this, database kNN is used instead of comparing them all in memory.
ops_set_faces_min_score_hint: Faces detected with less confidence are discarded.
ops_set_faces_suggestion_hint: Faces between the clustering threshold and this one are offered as suggestions.
ops_set_images_format_hint: WebP is smaller at the same quality. Applies to new ones; regenerate existing ones in Maintenance.
ops_set_images_quality_hint: From 1 to 100. Higher is sharper and heavier.
ops_set_invalid: Fix the marked fields to save.
ops_set_leave_text: Some settings were changed and not saved. Leaving now loses them.
ops_set_master_hint: Master switch: off, no photo goes through the model.
ops_set_metadata_desc: What is read from EXIF, IPTC and XMP.
ops_set_metadata_timezone_hint: For EXIF dates that don’t state their zone.
ops_set_nightly_desc: A daily cycle that catches up on whatever is pending.
ops_set_nightly_group_hint: Whether it’s processed in the nightly cycle (see Nightly tasks).
ops_set_nightly_modules_hint: “Pending only” processes what isn’t yet; “All” redoes everything every night.
ops_set_notifications_desc: Which notices are sent and how long they’re kept.
ops_set_notifications_max_hint: Past it, the oldest are deleted. 0 = no limit.
ops_set_notifications_retention_hint: Days a notification is kept. 0 = never deleted.
ops_set_objects_desc: Object detection for tagging and search.
ops_set_objects_max_hint: The most confident ones are kept.
ops_set_objects_min_score_hint: Objects detected with less confidence are discarded.
ops_set_objects_min_size_hint: Fraction of the image side (0.02 = 2%). Filters out tiny objects.
ops_set_performance_batch_hint: How many photos are queued per batch in the nightly run.
ops_set_performance_desc: How many photos each kind of task processes at once.
ops_set_performance_io_hint: Parallel workers while scanning and extracting.
ops_set_performance_ml_hint: Each worker holds a connection to the ML service.
ops_set_prefer_large_hint: Analyses the 1280 px thumbnail instead of the original: less disk reading, same result.
ops_set_scenes_min_score_hint: The most likely scene is always kept; the others only if they pass it.
ops_set_server_desc: Public address, upload and session limits, and the map.
ops_set_server_map_key_hint: Without a key, tiles carry a watermark. Get one free at carto.com/basemaps/apikey. Empty = no key.
ops_set_server_public_url_hint: Shared links are built with it. Empty = the address the server is reached at.
ops_set_server_session_hint: From 5 to 43,200 minutes (1440 = one day, 43,200 = 30 days).
ops_set_text_desc: Reading the text in images for search.
ops_set_text_max_hint: Cap per image, useful for dense documents.
ops_set_text_min_score_hint: Lines read with less confidence are discarded.
ops_set_trash_desc: How long deleted items are kept and how much room they may take.
ops_set_trash_enabled_hint: Off, deleted items are gone immediately.
ops_set_trash_retention_hint: Days until permanent deletion. 0 = kept forever.
ops_set_users_desc: Defaults when an account is created.
ops_tasks_background_hint: They keep going if you close this page. Finished ones are forgotten after an hour.
ops_tasks_empty: No tasks in the last hour.
ops_tasks_intro: What the server is doing now and did in the last hour, and the per-photo analysis queues.
ops_trash_cleanup_text: Trash items past the retention or the quota are permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
